summary: Mueller Industries filed an 8-K reporting its annual meeting results (director elections, auditor ratification, advisory say-on-pay) and a regular quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.35 per share, payable June 19, 2026, to shareholders of record June 5, 2026. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spinoff, rights offering, or other special situation. Both the shareholder vote and the dividend are routine, recurring events for a public company. Therefore, this 8-K is not a special-situation filing.
